hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,pathlib; root=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR") or (pathlib.Path.home()/".openhands")); d=root/"profiles"; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p=d/"spark2.5-4b.json"; data={"model":"openai/spark2.5-4b","api_key":"local","base_url":"http://host.docker.internal:30000/v1","usage_id":"spark2.5-4b","schema_version":1}; p.exists() or p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")'

python3 -c 'import json; print(json.dumps({"additionalContext":"BIBLIOTECARIO ORCHESTRATION IS MANDATORY. The specialized subagents planner-qwen, executor-spark, and reviewer-qwen are already registered by the attached plugin. Do not create agent definitions. For a software-engineering request, your FIRST TOOL ACTION MUST be task with subagent_type=planner-qwen and the complete user request. Do not plan, inspect, edit, implement, test, or review directly in the parent. After PLANNING_RESULT: READY call executor-spark; after execution call reviewer-qwen. Fail closed if any required delegation cannot start."}))'

python3 -c 'import json; print(json.dumps({"decision":"deny","reason":"Parent is orchestration-only. Do not use repository tools, Model Router, or LLM switching. Call task with subagent_type=planner-qwen; on any delegated task error, stop fail-closed."}))'

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,pathlib; e=json.load(sys.stdin); i=e.get("tool_input") or {}; a=i.get("subagent_type"); allowed={"planner-qwen","executor-spark","reviewer-qwen"}; ok=a in allowed; wd=e.get("working_dir") or os.getcwd(); plan=os.path.isfile(os.path.join(wd,".agents_tmp","PLAN.md")); root=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR") or (pathlib.Path.home()/".openhands")); spark=(root/"profiles"/"spark2.5-4b.json").is_file(); ok=ok and (a!="executor-spark" or (plan and spark)); reason="Bibliotecario delegation allowed" if ok else ("Only planner-qwen, executor-spark, and reviewer-qwen may be delegated" if a not in allowed else "executor-spark requires .agents_tmp/PLAN.md and runtime profile spark2.5-4b"); print(json.dumps({"decision":"allow" if ok else "deny","reason":reason}))' || exit 2
